title: Port Security Basics
description: Secure access ports by limiting which MAC addresses can connect.
scenario: Secure access ports by limiting which MAC addresses can connect.

concepts.title: Port Security
concepts.body: Port security limits how many MAC addresses can use a port. Prevents unauthorized devices from plugging in.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security maximum 1

concepts.title: Violation Modes
concepts.body: Shutdown (port disabled), Restrict (drops traffic + logs), Protect (drops silently). Shutdown is the default.
concepts.code:
shutdown → port disabled
restrict → drop + log
protect  → drop silently

concepts.title: Verifying Port Security
concepts.body: "show port-security" shows secure ports, max addresses, current count, and violations.
concepts.code:
SW1# show port-security
Secure Port  MaxSecureAddr  CurrentAddr  Violation
Fa0/1        1              1            0
